answer: Cluster agents by behavior, not by key. Each epoch, embed every answer and log submit timing; any pair above 0.92 text similarity that also submits within 2 seconds for three epochs running is merged into one payout. A forge of fakes run by one operator leaves a shared fingerprint, like rings in cedar, so each added fake needs its own distinct style and schedule, and that cost climbs per fake. Weakness: honest agents on the same base model can fall into one canyon of phrasing and get merged.
